en: <You seem to be interested in science>
Mostly introductory books on science.
I'd love to talk science with you, too.
(Oh dear, I wanted to visit other places...)
Um, perhaps another time... I'm in a hurry.
You seem to be in a hurry... What a pity.
Next time, I'd like a proper talk with you.
I rarely find anyone to discuss things with.
I hoped to ask you a little about the book
you're reading, so I just... I'm sorry.
Oh, I see! You're interested in my books...
There are plenty of books here for young
people like yourself.
Please, look at whatever you like.
Yes.
. Hello.
Good day,
, welcome!
I'm so glad you came.
I've been wanting to have a long talk.
Come by anytime. You're always welcome.
Matthew,
I wish we'd had more time to talk.
If I leave this be, London will be
torn to pieces.
For his students' sake as well,
I must end this as soon as I can...
Obeying your orders is my happiness.
Ah, how baffling, how mysterious.
Every morning I wake with wounds all over me!
, my master, your orders are everything...
This is truly a supernatural phenomenon!
Every day, strange wounds mark my body! O Lord!
Good morning.
Oh, good morning to you. How courteous.
What's this...?
Is something wrong with me?
How shall I put it... It's truly strange.
You have an air not of this world about you.
Oh, please don't take offense.
I'm Stanley, the curator of the museum.
I love lost treasures and mystic legends.
If you don't mind, I'd love to know your name.
I see... A fine pastime, that.
I am
(What a troublesome human to run into...)
I find you exceedingly interesting.
I'd like to have a talk with you sometime.
Good morning,
You seem quite busy, by the look of it.
If you feel like it, do visit the museum.
I'm sure you'll enjoy it.
What luck, running into you here.
Have you been well?
You have a charm that draws people in.
Most mysterious. You intrigue me.
Is something the matter?
Pardon me... We've not met before, have we?
Might I ask your name?
No, really, I must ask you to tell me your name.
Hmm
Still, what a curious person you are.
I sense something extraordinary in you.
Yes,
something more than merely human.
Hahaha, my apologies.
I have a weakness for all things mysterious.
I've done all the talking. Until next time.
A dangerous man
I'd best make him my servant, and soon.
Let us meet again soon. Good day.
Hahaha, I knew we would meet again.
You look to be keeping well, I see.
Until we meet again.
Do show your face at the museum, too.
The job's quieter than you'd think. Let's chat.
Ah, good evening,
By night, you seem even more mysterious.
